items.title: Model layer: add note storage to GroupState (max 10 lines, project-scoped), persist and restore it like the group name, and cover save/restore plus the 10-line cap with XGhosttyTests
Cmd+N note edit overlay: opens for the focused project, multi-line editing with full text visible, Esc saves and closes, terminal returns to full view

Overview mode (Cmd+Opt+N): toggle simultaneous note overlays on all visible projects, visible-only display set, zoom release on entry, read-only, truncated display; model-layer judgment logic covered by XGhosttyTests
Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe the note layer as implemented
Full verification: just build-app, just test, just swift-test all exit 0 with no regression of group features
Human on-device visual verification: Cmd+N overlay open/save, Cmd+Opt+N overview show/hide, overlay appearance, and note readability in overview (one-time, after all implementation)
Optional mouse affordance: open the focused project's note from the header band (or equivalent) by mouse
Optional visual refinement of the note edit overlay and overview mode (colors, margins, animation)
